request.query: Foreigner's identity card from the police

sources.title: poliisi.fi
highlights: You can be issued with an identity card if you are a foreign citizen permanently resident in Finland, your personal information, including municipality of residence in Finland, is entered in the Population Information System, and you have a valid residence permit or residence card or your right of residence has been registered
When applying for a foreigner’s identity card, you must present a valid passport or identity card

sources.title: poliisi.fi
highlights: For an identity card application, you will need one passport photo which has been taken no longer than 6 months earlier

sources.title: suomi.fi
highlights: The police can issue identity cards to foreign citizens who reside in Finland permanently, whose details have been entered in the Population Information System, and who have a valid residence permit or residence card or whose right of residence has been registered

sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: Applying for the identity card requires a personal visit at the Police station

sources.title: kaleva.fi
highlights: Tällä hetkellä seuraava vapaa aika on valittavissa kesäkuun puolenvälin jälkeen
Ajanvarausten lisäksi henkilöllisyystodistuksen voi uusia jonottamalla ilman ajanvarausta

sources.title: valtioneuvosto.fi
highlights: If you can’t find a suitable appointment time in the system immediately, it’s advisable to check the appointment times again, for example, the next day

sources.title: lifeaway.blog
highlights: Extra Important – The card will not be mailed to your home, but to a pick-up point of your choosing
Only someone with a Finnish-issued ID can collect the police card from the pick-up point
Bring your photo share code, DVV certificate, passport, and residence permit to your appointment
